newsitem.title: DUBAI: France, UAE end week of joint military exercises.
newsitem.headline: France, UAE end week of joint military exercises.

text.p: Troops from France and the United Arab Emirates ended a week of joint military exercises on Monday, the official UAE news agency WAM reported.
Senior army officials from both sides watched the exercises codenamed Gulf 96 involving live ammunition, jet fighters and an armoured offensive, WAM added.

Over 600 French troops and 160 vehicles backed by 18 aircraft and three ships took part in the war games, the largest such manoeuvre in the region this year involving French forces, the French Defence Ministry said last week.
The UAE, which has signed a defence pact with Paris, is a major French arms client. The Gulf state has already purchased planes, helicopters and tanks.
